summary: Frontend testing of updated /implants page for Zubite.bg. All 18 features tested and passed. Page structure follows Educate → Qualify → Capture Lead flow with Primary CTA 'Заяви обаждане' and Secondary CTA 'Направи бърза оценка'. Lead form submission tested successfully with success message displayed.
passed_tests: Hero H1 is 'Зъбни импланти – трайно решение за липсващи зъби'
Hero has primary CTA 'Заяви обаждане' linking to #lead-form (data-testid='hero-cta-primary')
Hero has secondary CTA 'Направи бърза оценка' linking to /implants/quiz (data-testid='hero-cta-secondary')
3 trust cards displayed in hero section
How Zubite Works section has 3 steps: Оценка или обаждане, Информация и цени, Избор на специалист
When Implants Used section has 4 use cases: Липсващ един зъб, Липсващи няколко зъба, Нестабилни протези, Пълна липса на зъби
Types of Implant Treatments section has 4 cards: Единичен имплант, Имплант мост, All-on-4/All-on-6, Стабилизиране на протези
Implant Systems section mentions Straumann, Nobel Biocare, Osstem, Megagen
Implant systems disclaimer about diagnosis importance is present
Prices section shows BGN secondary in parentheses (≈ 1400-4000 лв., ≈ 2400-6000 лв., ≈ 10000-18000 лв.)
Price disclaimer is present: 'Цените са ориентировъчни и зависят от сложността на случая'
Before You Choose Implants section lists 4 factors: Състояние на венците, Наличие на достатъчно кост, Общо здравословно състояние, Навици
Lead form has all required fields: Име, Телефон*, Град dropdown, Problem textarea, Consent checkbox
Lead form submit button says 'Заяви обаждане' (data-testid='lead-form-submit')
No clinic listings or rankings displayed
Educational disclaimer is present: 'Информацията е образователна и не замества преглед'
Lead form submission works - success message 'Благодарим! Нашият екип ще се свърже с вас скоро.' displayed
critical_code_review_comments: Page structure follows correct order: Hero → How Zubite Works → When Implants Used → Types of Implant Treatments → Implant Systems → Prices → Before You Choose Implants → FAQ → Lead Form
All data-testid attributes correctly implemented: hero-cta-primary, hero-cta-secondary, lead-form-name, lead-form-phone, lead-form-city, lead-form-problem, lead-form-consent, lead-form-submit
Pricing configuration properly uses EUR primary with BGN secondary
Lead form submits to /api/leads endpoint and displays success message correctly
Uses medically responsible tone - avoids claims like '100% безболезнено', uses safer wording: 'обикновено', 'в повечето случаи'
No clinic listings or rankings in main content as required
